description: Send one line to every client that is listening for log.line, optionally tagged with topic. Use it to test that a subscription works. The line is delivered at once. delivered is false when the server is not announcing log.line (events are off, or log.line is not selected), and next says how to turn it on. Nothing is stored except the recent-events buffer.

level.description: MCP logging level, default info. A client that called logging/setLevel only receives lines at or above its level.

line.description: The text to send, 1 to 200 characters. Do not put secrets in it.

topic.description: Tag for the event, so a listener can filter with ?topic=.

name: push_log
